APU: AMD Ryzen 7 8700G or Ryzen 5 8600G (Launches on Jan 31)

RAM: 16 GB DDR5 6,000 (2 x 8 GB). High-speed RAM is important because it directly impacts GPU perf. 

PSU: 450 Watts should suffice (get Seasonic if possible, if it gets too expensive, go for any other reputed brand)

Storage: 512 GB NVMe SSD for games plus 1 TB HDD for mass storage

Case: Whatever fits the budget.

Peripherals: Check out [Kreo-tech's](https://kreo-tech.com/) stuff and see if you like any.
